newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Klaus party to lead in Czech Senate elections-poll.
newsitem.headline: Klaus party to lead in Czech Senate elections-poll.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus's Civic Democratic Party (ODS) is likely to take the lead in Czech Senate elections later this month, an independent polling analyst said on Tuesday.
A survey conducted in October by pollsters Factum showed a decline in support for the opposition Social Democrats (CSSD), Factum director Jan Herzmann told a news conference.
The survey, which polled 1,064 Czechs, showed that 25.4 percent supported Klaus's ODS up from 23.7 in September, while support for the opposition CSSD fell to 20.2 percent from 24.4.
The survey did not project how many seats in the Senate, the new upper chamber of parliament with limited legislative powers, each party was likely to win.

The first-past-the-post election is scheduled for November 15-16. If no candidate wins more than 50 percent in any one constituency, the two top candidates must face each other in a second round a week later.
In a separate poll released on Monday, Factum preeicted an inconclusive first round after which 79 ODS candidates and 73 CSSD candidates would fight the decisive battle in a run-off.
